lines.cap:
Your AI agents can spend your money, email your customers
and delete your files.
lines.say: Your AI agents can spend your money, email your customers, and delete your files.

lines.cap: Vexen decides, every single time, whether they are allowed to.
lines.say: Vexen decides, every single time, whether they are actually allowed to.

lines.cap: Vexen sits in front of your agents. Every action goes through one call.
lines.say: Vexen sits in front of your agents. Every action goes through one call.

lines.cap: There are only ever three answers: Allowed, Blocked, or Needs your OK.
lines.say: And there are only ever three answers to learn. Allowed. Blocked. Or, needs your OK.

lines.cap: Getting started is one screen. Your name, your email, a password.
lines.say: Getting started is one screen. Your name, your email, a password.

lines.cap: Your workspace begins completely locked down — nothing can act for you yet.
lines.say: Your workspace begins completely locked down. Nothing can act on your behalf until you say so.

lines.cap: When you are ready, there are over ten thousand ready-made agents.
lines.say: When you are ready, there are over ten thousand ready-made agents.

lines.cap: Filter by the job, your field, and how much freedom you want to hand over.
lines.say: Filter by the job, the field you work in, and how much freedom you want to hand over.

lines.cap: Every one arrives already narrowed. Nobody starts from a blank page.
lines.say: Every one of them arrives already narrowed down. Nobody starts from a blank page.

lines.cap: Now the part that matters: ask what would happen if your agent tried something.
lines.say: Now the part that matters. Ask what would happen if your agent tried something.

lines.cap: $250 is over the cap — so Vexen pauses it and waits for a person.
lines.say: Two hundred and fifty dollars is over the cap, so Vexen pauses it and waits for a person.

lines.cap: Nothing has been bought.
lines.say: Nothing has been bought.

lines.cap: And it shows every check it made, in order — the same checks, every time.
lines.say: And it shows you every check it made, in the order it made them. The same checks, every single time.

lines.cap: Saved card details are refused outright.
lines.say: Saved card details are refused outright.

lines.cap: Even if somebody granted that permission by mistake, a rule stops it.
lines.say: Even if somebody granted that permission by mistake, a rule stops it.

lines.cap: You can write a safety rule the way you would say it out loud.
lines.say: You can write a safety rule the way you would say it out loud.

lines.cap: Vexen turns your sentence into a real rule and shows what it understood.
lines.say: Vexen turns your sentence into a real rule, and shows you exactly what it understood.

lines.cap: The AI writes rules. The AI never enforces them.
lines.say: Nothing is saved until you approve it. The A I writes rules. The A I never enforces them.

lines.cap: The moment an agent is paused, everyone allowed to decide gets an email.
lines.say: The moment an agent is paused, everyone allowed to decide gets an email.

lines.cap: Which agent, what it wants, how much, and which rule stopped it.
lines.say: Which agent, what it wants, how much, and which rule stopped it. Then two big buttons.

lines.cap: Tapping one opens a phone-sized page. No login, no app.
lines.say: Tapping one opens a phone sized page. No login, no app.

lines.cap: The link only ever shows the decision. Approving takes a deliberate second tap.
lines.say: The link only ever shows you the decision. Approving takes a deliberate second tap.

lines.cap: So a corporate link scanner can never approve a purchase on your behalf.
lines.say: So a corporate link scanner can never approve a purchase on your behalf.

lines.cap: Approvals are single use, expire in thirty minutes, and are bound to that action.
lines.say: Approvals are single use, they expire in thirty minutes, and they are bound to that exact action.

lines.cap: Same permission, same item, same amount — to the cent.
lines.say: Same permission, same item, same amount, to the cent.

lines.cap: For engineers it is one decorator around the function that spends the money.
lines.say: For engineers it is one decorator around the function that spends the money.

lines.cap: If Vexen blocks, that function never runs. If a human is needed, it waits.
lines.say: If Vexen blocks, that function never runs. If a human is needed, it waits, and then runs exactly once.

lines.cap: And if Vexen is unreachable, it still does not run. Fail closed is the default.
lines.say: And if Vexen is unreachable, it still does not run. Fail closed is the default.

lines.cap: Every decision is written down and sealed with a hash, so tampering shows up.
lines.say: Every decision is written down and sealed with a hash, so tampering shows up.

lines.cap: One click verifies the whole record.
lines.say: One click verifies the whole record. Evidence you can hand to somebody who does not trust you.

lines.cap: A standing safety check tells you, in plain words, what is worth tightening.
lines.say: A standing safety check tells you, in plain words, what is worth tightening.

lines.cap: And your team gets four roles, enforced on the server.
lines.say: And your team gets four roles, enforced on the server.

lines.cap: So whoever approves the money never has to be whoever edits the rules.
lines.say: So the person who approves the money never has to be the person who edits the rules.

lines.cap: Give AI power. Keep control.
lines.say: Give A I power. Keep control.

lines.cap: Vexen — free to start, and locked down from the first second.
lines.say: Vexen. Free to start, and locked down from the very first second.
